title: Seed Biology, Germination & Seedling Establishment
description: Specialist module covering seed identity and reproductive origin, viability and vigor, evidence-based germination, seedling establishment, sanitation, traceability and batch troubleshooting.
learningOutcomes: Analyze seed identity, lot provenance, reproductive origin and basic seed anatomy before selecting or documenting a germination workflow.
Differentiate viability, vigor, germination percentage, germination rate and seedling establishment so propagation records do not treat these as interchangeable outcomes.
Evaluate germination conditions using cannabis/hemp evidence while separating research-treatment values from facility-specific operating targets.
Assess seedling establishment using root-zone moisture, aeration, media condition, sanitation and developmental evidence rather than a single visual symptom.
Create a reconstructable seed-to-seedling batch record that preserves identity, denominator, timing, abnormal outcomes, interventions, uncertainty and escalation.
